entities.summary: Axel Joseph Jean-Jacques Toupane is a French professional basketball player for FC Porto of the Liga Portuguesa de Basquetebol (LPB). Toupane also represents the senior French national team in international events. At 2.01 m tall and 101 kg (223 lb), he plays at the shooting guard and small forward positions.
